visual_concept: Premium deep space exploration, upward momentum, focus, high contrast, and energetic progress.

iconography.style: Duotone or Bold for active tabs, Regular/Light for inactive. Rocket motifs for main actions, target/bullseye for goals, trajectory arrows for progress.

cards.shadow: Subtle elevation shadow in Light mode. No shadow, just crisp border in Dark mode.

bottom_tab_navigation.layout: Fixed bottom bar. Optional: Floating island style with 24px side margins and 16px bottom margin, fully rounded.

dashboard.name: Início
key_elements: Greeting header: 'Olá, [Nome]' with Avatar.
Main highlight: Large circular progress ring showing daily goals completed vs pending.
Motivational phrase section: italic, muted typography.
Today's Goals List (Metas de Hoje): concise cards, quick complete action.
CTA: Prominent 'Criar nova meta' FAB (Floating Action Button) or large sticky bottom button.

goals_list.name: Metas
key_elements: Horizontal scrollable chips for filters: Status (Pendente, Em andamento, Concluída), Priority (Alta, Média, Baixa), Categories.
Goal Cards: Title, Date, Priority badge, Category icon.
Interactions: Swipe left to delete/edit, swipe right to mark as complete (React Native Reanimated).

goal_creation.name: Criar Meta
key_elements: Modal/BottomSheet view.
Inputs: Title (large text input), Description (multiline).
Date & Time pickers.
Segmented control or chips for Priority.
Grid of clickable icons/chips for Category (Estudos, Trabalho, Saúde, Finanças, Espiritual, Pessoal, Família, Empreendedorismo, Outros).
Status selection (default Pendente).

planning.name: Planejamento
key_elements: Top segmented toggle: Hoje | Semana | Mês.
Grouped list view by Date or Category.
Timeline style connecting lines on the left.

history.name: Histórico
key_elements: 2x2 Grid of Stat Cards: Metas Concluídas, Dias Produtivos, Taxa de Conclusão, Melhor Sequência.
Bar chart or Line graph showing 'Evolução da Semana' (completed goals per day).

profile.name: Perfil
key_elements: Large centered Avatar and User Name.
Settings List: Theme Toggle (Light/Dark), Motivational Phrases Toggle, Clear Data.
Space-themed abstract background at the very top header of the profile.

testing_instructions.data_testid: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, list items, toggles, tab items) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case. Example: 'data-testid="create-goal-button"', 'data-testid="goal-card-1"', 'data-testid="theme-toggle"'.

profile_header_bg.description: Rocket launch light trail at dusk. Ideal for a motivational background in the Profile screen header or Onboarding.

onboarding_rocket.description: Spacecraft taking off. Good for empty states or welcome screens.
